page.overview:
Who is Alfred Nettle?

Alfred Nettle (fl. 1986) was a wizard who ran the Apothecary in Diagon Alley in the mid 1980s.

Alfred was well acquainted with Penny Haywood, as she was a frequent customer of his shop.

Before the 1986–1987 school year, Alfred helped Jacob's sibling and Penny Haywood brew Doxycide to neutralise the Doxies attacking the Leaky Cauldron. He also agreed to replenish the destroyed potion ingredients after Jacob's sibling helped him receive a delivery from Jae Kim.
